meta.titleSuffix: The AI Infrastructure Control Layer for SaaS
meta.description: Fonderie helps founders ship SaaS to market faster. It ships a playbook that lives in your repo and guides your AI to build a SaaS the right way — auth, billing, teams, security, permissions, all tested and documented. It gives your AI the foundations every SaaS needs, so you're not rebuilding or re-explaining them every session. Focus on your product and your customers — Fonderie gives your AI the context and building blocks to turn your idea into a production-ready SaaS.

footer.tagline: The control layer for AI-built SaaS.
